scientific_integrity: All-length combinatorial proof with independent finite enumeration; no claim of independent certification or verified historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Only binary circles with exactly three occurrences of 1; the border-correlation rule fails already for four ones. The complete 2004 foundational article was not accessible for priority assessment. Finite checker supports but does not replace the all-length proof.
title: Three-marker border correlation: a local gap law and its exact distribution
